svg.text: Reviewed mixed-degree addition components
Cancellation: field and word
Input validity implies ordinate +/- alternatives, excludes mismatch branch; cancellation output has
nonzero weights and normalized validity. Field; shared support; both normalized input divisibilities;
four nonzero weights. Repeated root/zero ordinate allowed.
Exact prelude/degree-one output decode and canonicality; guards agree; conditional word cancellation
validity. Prime 5<=p<2^31; 10 canonical coordinates; four nonzero weights; both normalized input
validities.
Generic branch: field
Interpolation and explicit degree-two residual establish nonzero output weights and normalized
validity under generic K!=0. Field; monic quintic without X4; four nonzero weights; both input
validities; K!=0. Repeated output support and zero interpolation slope are allowed. This establishes
polynomial divisibility, not a divisor-class sum.
Generic branch: literal UInt64
Six canonical decoded payloads; zero guard and Option correspondence; outer/generic K equality;
conditional output validity. Prime 5<=p<2^31; 10 canonical coordinates plus curve[3]; validity adds
nonzero weights, input validity and K!=0. The actual generic formula uses explicit squares; no pow
loop. Literal output w=1 is canonical. The other curve coefficients enter the validity statement as
field values.
What the reviews checked
Separate module, control and axiom readbacks passed. Cancellation review covers both field and word
modules; generic field and generic word have separate reviews. Only standard Lean axioms were read
back. Original failed attempts and control corrections remain in their packets.
Source assumptions and remaining branches
Machine scope is Field n=1, tables=None and normal counter execution. Pure value bundles may define
unused outputs beyond an early-return guard; no operation-count or side-effect equivalence is
asserted. No compiler/linkage, class-sum, tripling, secondary positive-coincidence output or whole-
walk theorem is claimed. Polynomial controls do not assert smooth curve preprocessing.
Publication and software snapshot
Canonical integration is pending final root configuration. Boxed maintained Clippy: exit0, sources
unchanged. Typed retained-data tests, full library and CLI checks remain pending root terminal review
in this snapshot. These software gates are separate from mathematical component review.
